column2: The Albanian Peace Articles Take Effect

The Ottoman government has accepted the Albanian settlement as a term of peace. Its authority over the specified districts now gives way to an Albanian administration under Italian protection. The treaty creates that administration where none existed and binds it to Italy: it is an imposed settlement, not an invitation which another cabinet can reject. Officials receive the signed articles, the garrisons change command and the ministry records the new protectorate. Sovereignty over lands outside the settlement remains untouched.
Publish the peace articles and establish the protectorate.
